title: Security Hardening
meta: Lock down access, secrets and open ports in your cloud setup to cut the chance of a breach. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Security hardening for your cloud servers and accounts
overview: We review how your cloud account and servers are set up and close the gaps that attackers look for: open ports, weak passwords, shared logins, secrets stored in code, missing updates and over-wide permissions. We fix what we can safely fix, and list the rest in order of importance. You get a before and after summary and a short checklist your team can keep using.

faq: Is this the same as a penetration test?

No. This is a configuration review and fix, based on common best practice. A penetration test tries to break in and is done by a security specialist. We say so in the report if you would benefit from one.
We test each change on staging or in a quiet window, and we write down every change so it can be undone. The riskiest steps, such as closing ports, are checked against how your app really connects.
We need an admin-level user in your account for the length of the order, which you create and remove yourself. Never share your own login. We list every setting we changed.
Do you cover compliance like ISO or PCI?
No. We do not provide certification or legal advice. A hardened set-up supports that kind of work, and our change list can be handed to your auditor.
